Container.Name: FalconBeat
Container.Overview: Synced light-show audio for Falcon Player (FPP). Visitors open a webpage on their phones and hear the show audio in sync with the lights. Requires the fpp-plugin-FalconBeat plugin on your FPP controller, and a Cloudflare Tunnel (or equivalent HTTPS ingress) pointed at the WebUI port for public access.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Public edge port — point cloudflared here (listener page, /media audio, /ws WebSocket proxy)

Config.Name: BeatSync Admin/API Port
Config.Description: LAN ONLY — plugin admin WebSocket + upload/complete. Do NOT expose to the internet

Config.Name: Ingest Port
Config.Description: LAN ONLY — plugin pushes audio files here. Do NOT expose to the internet

Config.Name: Media Directory
Config.Description: Show audio pushed by the FPP plugin lands here; Caddy serves it at /media/*

Config.Name: Creator Secret
Config.Description: Admin auth for the FPP plugin's admin WebSocket (?creator=). Long random string. Paste the same value into the plugin's Creator Secret field

Config.Name: Ingest Token
Config.Description: Bearer token for audio PUTs from the FPP plugin. Long random string. Paste the same value into the plugin's Ingest Token field
